about_the_game:
Balaspire is a roguelike where two of the best deckbuilder mechanics meet: spell-card casting and card-matching combos. Throw out cards to cast powerful spells, and then form hand-combos of matching cards to hit your enemies hard!

Element and Rune-based Combo Matching System

Match up elements and runes to rack up bigger numbers when you attack!

Spells and Trinkets Deckbuilding

Matching-combos aren’t the only way to hit hard – fill your deck with spells and discover trinkets that synergise with your strategy to grow your power exponentially!

An Ever Devolving Tower, Down Into The Depths…

Descend down the Balaspire – a mysterious subterranean tower where the deeper you go, the stranger things become…

Different Characters for Different Playstyles

Each character has a focus on different strategies for you to explore as you make your runs down into the dungeons.

short_description: A chaotic fusion of two of the best deckbuilder roguelike mechanics into one explosive dungeon-crawling adventure! Battle monsters, collect powerful trinkets, build your ultimate deck, and uncover the secrets of the Balaspire as you descend down into its dungeons.
